examples.name: teleop
examples.description: Open keyboard teleop in this terminal. It starts disarmed; SPACE arms future key commands. Q returns after the current jog finishes.

examples.name: moveit2
examples.description: Open the M-10iA MoveIt planning interface and RViz using the existing real driver. This does not request a plan or Execute; use the GUI deliberately. Ctrl+C here closes the launch and returns to the assistant.
